'''Azi al'Thone''' is a young adult from the [[Two Rivers]]. 

== Activities ==
He is one of the Two Rivers men that now follow [[Perrin Aybara]] in [[Ghealdan]]. He acts as Perrin's bodyguard when Perrin goes to survey the [[Children of the Light]] camp.
He then acts as Perrin's bodyguard the day of Perrin's trial. He moves right beside Perrin when Perrin is deemed guilty.
He is present when Perrin creates ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' and then declares to his followers his acceptance at becoming their Lord and leader.

He [[Traveling|Travels]] through with Perrin and the rest of his huge force to the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]]. 

== Trivia ==
* Azi al'Thone is named for Anthony Aziz, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
